t: This is Sir John Soane's Museum, next to Lincoln's Inn Fields in Holborn. It was the home of the neo-classical architect John Soane, who designed it, owned it and founded it as a museum. It holds his architectural drawings and models, plus paintings, sculptures and antiquities he collected. A private Act of Parliament set it up, taking effect on his death in 1837, and it was to be kept as nearly as possible as he left it. Two later architects, Wyatt Papworth and James William Wild, died here. Wild was curator from 1878.
